summary: Flat crest of a steep residential street, homes about 12 m away.

best_section.where: South kerb at the crest, between the two townhouse blocks

drivers.seclusion: Dense housing; mapped dwellings 10-12 m away on the south side and 17 m on the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a few cars parked on the south side; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street between two junctions, not a through route.
drivers.convention: Only a few cars parked in the imagery, so a van would stand out a little.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on the same side
Steep: mean grade 9.8%, over 13% on the climb to the crest
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree canopy shades the road near 0-25 m and the north verge.
